system.description:
You can direct the radiance of your starlight’s towards an ally, marking them as your bait for the next fish caught in your trap. As a bonus action, by spending 1 Stellar Charges you can select one allied creature within 60 feet of you. Until the beginning of your next turn, that ally begins glowing with a soft plasma like light and can reroll one attack roll or check they make, taking the new result. If a hostile creature makes a melee attack against the chosen ally, all Starlight’s within 60 feet can trigger at your discretion. If you let them, you can spend your reaction, and all Starlight’s fire a Plasma Burst, at the triggering creature. Make an attack for each triggering Starlight.

Beginning at 7th level, the select ally gains a +2 bonus to their AC and their next saving throw for the duration. Beginning at 15th level, You can target two allies with this feature, instead of one. You also gain an additional Reaction, which you can only use to trigger this features Starlight attacks.
